parameters.name: q

schema.description: Free-text search on the message content (summary and full archived body), plus resolved project/workflow/node name. A `user:<name>` term (or `user:"name"`) narrows to that user's audit events by an exact match on the event's user field; the rest of the text is searched as usual
schema.title: Q

parameters.description: Free-text search on the message content (summary and full archived body), plus resolved project/workflow/node name. A `user:<name>` term (or `user:"name"`) narrows to that user's audit events by an exact match on the event's user field; the rest of the text is searched as usual

parameters.name: user

schema.description: Narrow to one user's audit events by an exact match on the event's user field (the same filter as a `user:<name>` term in `q`). Supplied explicitly by the search box's User qualifier and the Users-page activity link. If both this and a `user:` term in `q` are present, this wins.
schema.title: User

parameters.description: Narrow to one user's audit events by an exact match on the event's user field (the same filter as a `user:<name>` term in `q`). Supplied explicitly by the search box's User qualifier and the Users-page activity link. If both this and a `user:` term in `q` are present, this wins.

parameters.name: direction

schema.description: Which side of `cursor` to read: `older` (the next page down) or `newer` (the page above it; needs `cursor`)
schema.title: Direction

parameters.description: Which side of `cursor` to read: `older` (the next page down) or `newer` (the page above it; needs `cursor`)

parameters.name: raw_search

schema.description: Match the free-text search against the unmasked message content. Honoured only for a caller with the 'Unredact PHI' (logs.unredact) permission; otherwise, and by default, the search matches only the masked text. The rows come back masked either way.
